key.mobtalk.gift: Give one item from your hand to the chosen mob
mobtalk.settings.title: Mob Talk Settings
mobtalk.settings.test.tooltip: Hold the talk key on the test screen. The test uses only local Whisper.
mobtalk.settings.whisper.url.tooltip: Only http://127.0.0.1:port or http://localhost:port. Model, language and device apply when a new helper starts.
mobtalk.settings.save.failed: Could not save settings. Please retry.
mobtalk.settings.list.empty: No microphones found. Check Windows microphone access.
mobtalk.settings.list.failed: Could not list microphones. Check Windows microphone access.
mobtalk.test.title: Microphone Test
mobtalk.test.instructions: Hold %s and speak (up to %s sec.), then release. Local Whisper recognizes your speech.
mobtalk.test.ready: Ready to test. Recording has not started.
mobtalk.test.too_short: Recording too short. Hold %s and say a phrase.
mobtalk.test.no_speech: No speech recognized. Hold %s and retry.
mobtalk.test.success: Microphone and Whisper work. Hold %s to test again.
mobtalk.test.microphone_busy: Microphone is finishing a recording or unavailable. Release the key and retry.
mobtalk.test.focus_lost: Test cancelled: window lost focus. Release the key and retry.
mobtalk.test.failed: Could not test microphone. Check Windows access and local Whisper.
mobtalk.test.scroll.tooltip: Scroll the transcript (mouse wheel also works).
mobtalk.settings.tab.general.full: On/off, vision, HUD line, how mobs call you, keys
mobtalk.settings.reset.draft: Defaults restored in the draft. Save to apply.
mobtalk.settings.reset.tooltip: Restore default preferences in the draft. Cancel before saving to discard.
mobtalk.settings.rudeness.tooltip: How rude and profane mobs are. Angry and rude characters swear more than kind ones.
mobtalk.settings.microphone.cycle: Click for next device; Shift for previous.
mobtalk.settings.search: Find a species by name or ID
mobtalk.settings.species.tooltip: %s (%s). Click to cycle; Shift to go back.
mobtalk.settings.archetype.label: Archetype
mobtalk.settings.voice.id.tooltip: Blank keeps the library assignment. Existing individual voices are edited in the mob profile.
mobtalk.settings.voice.preview.tooltip: Play existing ElevenLabs library audio. This does not test OpenRouter generation.
mobtalk.settings.voice.test.tooltip: Generate a short phrase through OpenRouter Flash v2.5 using your account credits.
mobtalk.settings.voice.phrase: Hello! I can speak calmly or expressively, notice important details and answer your questions. Let's check how clearly this voice sounds.
mobtalk.settings.mob.empty: Aim at a living mob and press V first.
mobtalk.settings.mob.loadFailed: Could not load the profile. Select the mob again.
mobtalk.settings.mob.name: Conversation name
mobtalk.settings.mob.clearPending: Exchanges will be cleared when saved. Edit memory separately.
mobtalk.settings.mob.request.tooltip: The LLM considers this request using personality, attitude and current context.
mobtalk.settings.operation.failed: Action failed. Refresh the profile and retry.
mobtalk.friend.stay.start: %s stays here and waits; release it with STOP or the cancel button
mobtalk.friend.guard.player: %s guards you; release it with STOP or the cancel button
mobtalk.friend.guard.here: %s guards this place; release it with STOP or the cancel button
mobtalk.friend.spare.label: leave %s alone
mobtalk.editor.count: %s / %s characters · Changes stay in the draft
mobtalk.editor.readonly: Read only · Ctrl+A, Ctrl+C to copy
mobtalk.test.play.failed: Could not play the recording. Check Windows output device.
mobtalk.test.compare.tooltip: Reuse one saved WAV for all selected models sequentially. Missing models will download; only one model is loaded at a time.
mobtalk.test.compare.running: Starting comparison with the same recording…
mobtalk.test.compare.done: Models finished: %s. Open results and choose one.
mobtalk.test.results.empty: No results yet. Hold the talk key on the Record tab.
mobtalk.settings.mob.resetPersonality.to: Rerolls temperament and personal traits after Save. Keeps voice, memory, history and relationships.
mobtalk.settings.mob.resetPending: Individuality will be rerolled after Save.
mobtalk.settings.mob.memoryPending: Memory summary will be cleared after Save. History and relationships are kept.
mobtalk.settings.connection.tooltip: Checks access and keys: the selected reply provider and OpenRouter for speech. Does not run a paid LLM or speech.
mobtalk.settings.tab.species.full: Character and voice of every species and its three archetypes
mobtalk.settings.key.paste.tooltip: Paste the key from the clipboard (or Ctrl+V in the field). The key is shown as asterisks.
mobtalk.settings.key.empty: Paste a key into the field first.
mobtalk.settings.key.failed: Could not save the OpenRouter key.
mobtalk.settings.key.hint: Windows encrypts the keys for your account; they never go into mobtalk.json.
mobtalk.settings.microphone.label: Microphone
mobtalk.settings.provider.tooltip: Who writes the mobs' replies. The speech provider is chosen separately below.
mobtalk.settings.provider.veniceModels: Venice models, e.g. deepseek-v4-1-flash, venice-uncensored-1-2, claude-haiku-5-5
mobtalk.settings.key.remove.tooltip.open: Removes the key saved from this menu or in config/mobtalk-openrouter-token.txt. OPENROUTER_API_KEY is not changed.
mobtalk.settings.key.remove.tooltip.veni: Removes the key saved from this menu or in config/mobtalk-venice-token.txt. VENICE_API_KEY is not changed.
mobtalk.settings.key.environment.openrou: Using OPENROUTER_API_KEY (%s); the variable overrides the menu key.
mobtalk.settings.key.environment.venice: Using VENICE_API_KEY (%s); the variable overrides the menu key.
mobtalk.settings.key.none.openrouter: No key yet. Paste your OpenRouter key below.
mobtalk.settings.key.none.venice: No key yet. Paste your Venice key below.
mobtalk.settings.tts.tooltip: Who voices the replies. OpenRouter: ElevenLabs voices by id from the species catalog. Venice: tts-elevenlabs-turbo-v2-5 uses the same voice ids, other Venice models use one voice for every mob.
mobtalk.settings.tts.veniceNote: Venice: tts-elevenlabs-turbo-v2-5 keeps the per-mob ElevenLabs voice ids (the Venice voice field is then unused); tts-kokoro and others use one voice for all (af_sky, af_bella, am_adam…), none of them Russian.
mobtalk.settings.stateHud: Mob's state in the Mob Talk line
mobtalk.settings.vision: Vision: a screenshot with the question
mobtalk.settings.vision.tooltip: A shot of what you see goes to the model with the question (~300 tokens, +0.3–1 s). "When there is a reason": a first meeting, a request to look, or an odd place (pit, chamber, cage). The place facts outrank the picture.
mobtalk.settings.social: Mobs act on their relations with each other
mobtalk.settings.socialLayer.tooltip: Characters, gestures (joke, compliment, hug, flirt, kiss), gifts, hearts, marriage, children and village standing. Villagers only.
mobtalk.settings.playerGender.tooltip: For courtship and marriage with villagers: a villager agrees only if drawn to your gender. "Not counted" skips the check.
mobtalk.settings.familyLife.tooltip: Villagers marry each other, children are born only to couples (villager+villager, you+spouse) and grow longer than vanilla's 20 minutes. While on, vanilla villager breeding is off.
mobtalk.family.wedding: [Mob Talk] A wedding in the village: %s and %s
mobtalk.village.noTrade: The village exiled you: villagers will not trade with you
mobtalk.settings.decider.tooltip: Rules: deterministic, no requests. Jev: a small decision model on the OpenRouter key (~$0.0001 per decision, under a second); the rules answer on failure.
mobtalk.settings.bargainHud: Haggling progress in the Mob Talk line
mobtalk.settings.tab.model.full: Reply provider and model, reasoning, background model, decider, keys
mobtalk.settings.tab.talk.full: Reply length and rudeness, bystanders, mob state, memory
mobtalk.settings.tab.social.full: Families, gifts, hearts, mob bonds, rumours, initiative, village standing
mobtalk.settings.tab.actions.full: Stay and guard requests, trade and place analysis
mobtalk.settings.enabled.tooltip: Master switch: without it mobs neither listen nor answer and their social life stops.
mobtalk.settings.stateHud.tooltip: One word about the selected mob's feelings in the Mob Talk line.
mobtalk.settings.bargainHud.tooltip: While haggling, the Mob Talk line shows whether the mob leans towards a concession.
mobtalk.settings.names.hint: Comma-separated names, up to 10 per list and 30 characters each. Empty means your Minecraft nick.
mobtalk.settings.names.neutral.tooltip: The first name is the one everybody knows you by: facts, memory, witnesses, rumours. The rest are ordinary forms of address.
mobtalk.settings.names.close.tooltip: Used by mobs whose relationship reaches the friend heart (40 by default). Empty uses the ordinary names.
mobtalk.settings.names.hostile.tooltip: Used by mobs with a relationship of −20 or below. Empty uses the ordinary names.
mobtalk.settings.keys.commands: /mobtalk info — mob and village, /mobtalk state — state, /mobtalk say <text> — type a line
mobtalk.settings.llm.tooltip: Model id at the selected provider, e.g. openai/gpt-6-luna.
mobtalk.settings.reasoning.tooltip: OpenRouter reasoning models think before answering. Minimal saves seconds per line; not sent leaves it to the provider.
mobtalk.settings.backgroundModel.tooltip: A cheap model for work nobody waits for: conversation summaries, reflections, rumours.
mobtalk.settings.commonPrompt.tooltip: A common addition to every mob's character: manner, limits, tone. Not reset by the section button.
mobtalk.settings.social.tooltip: Mobs act on how they feel about each other: friends drift together, enemies apart, a friend visits a mourner.
mobtalk.settings.initiative.tooltip: Creatures speak first on an occasion: your return, an open deal, a friend nearby, building, weather.
mobtalk.settings.placeAnalysis.tooltip: The mob understands where it stands: walled in or not, exits, height, objects around.
mobtalk.settings.placeClassifier.tooltip: A small classifier names the place (mine, house, cave); tens of milliseconds off the game thread.
mobtalk.settings.place.note: The radius and flood-fill limits of the place analysis are fixed for now.
mobtalk.settings.tts.keyNote: Provider keys are entered on the Model tab.
mobtalk.settings.resetSection.tooltip: This tab's numbers and switches return to defaults in the draft. Texts, microphone, names and keys stay. Cancel to undo.
mobtalk.settings.resetSection.done: Tab reset in the draft. Press Save to apply.
mobtalk.tune.maxDistance.tooltip: How far from a mob you may stand to talk to it. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.maxReplyWords.tooltip: How many words a mob may say in one line. Longer means slower speech and costlier requests.
mobtalk.tune.maxRecordingSeconds.tooltip: How long one hold of the talk key may record. 15 seconds at most.
mobtalk.tune.whisperBeamSize.tooltip: How many hypotheses Whisper keeps. Higher is more accurate but slower. Applies after Whisper restarts.
mobtalk.tune.whisperVadSilenceMs.tooltip: Silence after which Whisper ends a phrase. Milliseconds.
mobtalk.tune.whisperCpuThreads.tooltip: CPU threads Whisper uses without a GPU.
mobtalk.tune.requestTimeoutSeconds.toolt: Seconds to wait for the model or speech before giving up.
mobtalk.tune.witnessReplies.tooltip: How many bystanders may add a line after the mob you talk to (0–2).
mobtalk.tune.witnessHearingRange.tooltip: Within this radius mobs hear the player's insults and threats and may chip in. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.witnessSightRange.tooltip: Within this radius mobs notice the player's blows, kills and misdeeds. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.witnessCooldownSeconds: A witness counts a deed once per %s s
mobtalk.tune.witnessCooldownSeconds.tool: Within this time repeated blows seen by one mob do not add up (a kill after blows still counts). Seconds.
mobtalk.tune.witnessHitPenalty.tooltip: How much a mob that saw the player hit another creature likes the player less.
mobtalk.tune.witnessKillPenalty.tooltip: Relationship drop for a mob that saw a kill. Monsters and attackers can be fought freely.
mobtalk.tune.witnessInsultPenalty.toolti: Relationship drop for a bystander who heard the player insult a mob.
mobtalk.tune.witnessThreatPenalty.toolti: Relationship drop for a bystander who heard a death threat.
mobtalk.tune.smallTalkChance: Chance to chip in without cause: %s%%
mobtalk.tune.smallTalkChance.tooltip: The chance a bystander adds a line with no special occasion (rule decider). Percent.
mobtalk.tune.stateHalfLifeMinutes.toolti: Half-life of mood, calm, interest and trust after ordinary events. Minutes.
mobtalk.tune.stateSlowHalfLifeMinutes.to: Half-life after a blow, a kill, a threat or a big favour. Not below the ordinary one. Minutes.
mobtalk.tune.waryCalm.tooltip: Below this calm (0–100) a mob makes no concessions and no deals.
mobtalk.tune.waryTrust.tooltip: Below this trust (0–100) a mob makes no concessions or deals; it speaks up less too.
mobtalk.tune.keenInterest.tooltip: From this interest (0–100) an acquainted mob turns to an approaching player.
mobtalk.tune.generousMood.tooltip: Together with trust above its threshold the mob haggles more generously. 0–100.
mobtalk.tune.generousTrust.tooltip: Together with mood above its threshold the mob haggles more generously. 0–100.
mobtalk.tune.historyTurns.tooltip: How many recent exchanges go to the model. More remembers better, costs more.
mobtalk.tune.maxMemoryChars.tooltip: Limit of a mob's long-term memory text (facts about you). Characters.
mobtalk.tune.memoryHalfLifeDays: Facts fade by half in %s days
mobtalk.tune.memoryHalfLifeDays.tooltip: How fast old facts give way to new ones when memory is full. Real days.
mobtalk.tune.memoryFloorPercent.tooltip: The floor of a fact's freshness: a month-old blow still outweighs yesterday's small talk. Percent.
mobtalk.tune.memoryMaxFacts.tooltip: How many separate facts a mob keeps about the world and the player.
mobtalk.tune.conversationSilenceMinutes: Conversation ends after %s min of silence
After this pause the conversation is summarised. Minutes.
mobtalk.tune.reflectionReplies.tooltip: How many replies pass before a mob draws conclusions about the player.
mobtalk.tune.reflectionImportance.toolti: Total importance of events since last time needed for a reflection.
mobtalk.tune.reflectionCooldownSeconds.t: Minimum pause between one mob's reflections. Seconds.
mobtalk.tune.weddingChance.tooltip: Chance each minute that a village near you holds a wedding. Percent.
mobtalk.tune.birthChance.tooltip: Chance each minute that a married villager couple has a child. Percent.
mobtalk.tune.childGrowthDays: Child grows up in %s game days
mobtalk.tune.childGrowthDays.tooltip: Game days for a child to pass four stages to adulthood.
mobtalk.tune.foodGiftHearts.tooltip: Relationship from an animal's first favourite food; each repeat gives 2 less.
mobtalk.tune.giftSaturationPercent.toolt: How fast identical gifts get boring. 0 means never. Percent.
mobtalk.tune.giftHeartsPercent.tooltip: Share of a gift's value that turns into relationship. Percent.
mobtalk.tune.gestureFatigueMinutes.toolt: How fast a villager recovers from jokes, hugs and flirting. Minutes per point.
mobtalk.tune.giftForgetMinutes.tooltip: Every this many minutes a villager forgets the oldest gift and enjoys it again. Minutes.
mobtalk.tune.heartsFriend.tooltip: From this relationship a villager counts you a friend and mobs use your close names.
mobtalk.tune.heartsDating.tooltip: From this relationship a villager accepts a bouquet. Not below the friend step.
mobtalk.tune.heartsMarriage.tooltip: From this relationship a villager accepts a ring; children with you need it too.
mobtalk.tune.socialActionsPerMinute.tool: How many walks to friends and away from enemies per minute in a world.
mobtalk.tune.socialPlayerRange.tooltip: Beyond this distance from the player no social life happens. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.socialApproachChance: Chance to walk to a friend: %s%%
mobtalk.tune.socialApproachChance.toolti: Chance per check (every 2 s) that a mob walks to a friend in sight. Percent.
mobtalk.tune.socialApproachMin: Walks to a friend beyond %s blocks
mobtalk.tune.socialApproachMin.tooltip: Closer than this the friend is already near. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.socialApproachMax.tooltip: Further than this the friend is too far to walk to. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.socialRetreatRange: Steps away from a rival within %s blocks
mobtalk.tune.socialRetreatRange.tooltip: A rival closer than this makes the mob step away. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.bondHalfLifeHours: Bonds between mobs halve in %s h
mobtalk.tune.bondHalfLifeHours.tooltip: How fast mob friendships and feuds fade without meetings. Real hours.
mobtalk.tune.griefMinutes.tooltip: How long a mob mourns a dead friend or relative. Minutes.
mobtalk.tune.rumorForgetDays.tooltip: A rumour weighs less each day and is gone after this many game days.
mobtalk.tune.rumorsPerVillage.tooltip: How many rumours a village keeps at once.
mobtalk.tune.rumorsPerVillager.tooltip: How many rumours one villager knows.
mobtalk.tune.rumorSpreadPercent.tooltip: Base chance a rumour passes between villagers who meet (weightier and closer ones more often). Percent.
mobtalk.tune.rumorsInPrompt.tooltip: How many of the weightiest rumours a villager has in mind while talking.
mobtalk.tune.rumorChronicleImportance.to: Importance of new events after which the village chronicle is written before the day is out.
mobtalk.tune.initiativesPerMinute.toolti: How often per minute creatures may speak first in the world.
mobtalk.tune.initiativeMobCooldownMinute: One mob speaks first once per %s min
Pause between one creature's initiatives. Minutes.
mobtalk.tune.initiativeReturnMinutes.too: Absence after which an acquaintance greets your return. Minutes.
mobtalk.tune.initiativeSpeakRange.toolti: Distance from which a mob calls out to the player. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.initiativeHearRange: You hear initiatives up to %s blocks
mobtalk.tune.initiativeHearRange.tooltip: Beyond this the player would not hear, so the mob keeps quiet. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.initiativeMetRange.tooltip: Closer than this the mob counts as having seen the player. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.sceneMaxLines: Scene between mobs: up to %s lines
mobtalk.tune.sceneMaxLines.tooltip: How many lines mobs may exchange in one scene (from 2).
mobtalk.tune.villageExilePoints.tooltip: Sum of residents' relationships and rumours at which the village exiles you: no trade, the golem watches.
mobtalk.tune.villageSuspectPoints.toolti: Below this you are a suspect: villagers warn you, the golem keeps an eye on you.
mobtalk.tune.villageFriendPoints.tooltip: From these points (and three acquainted villagers) you are one of the village.
mobtalk.tune.villageGuardPoints.tooltip: From these points (and five acquaintances) you are the village's guardian.
mobtalk.tune.villageElderPoints.tooltip: From these points (eight acquaintances, a village of ten) you are the village head.
mobtalk.tune.friendLeaseMinutes.tooltip: How many game minutes a mob keeps STAY, GUARD or SPARE without being asked again.
mobtalk.tune.friendLeaveRange: Gives up if you are beyond %s blocks
mobtalk.tune.friendLeaveRange.tooltip: Go further and the mob ends the request (except SPARE). Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.guardNear.tooltip: When walking back the guard comes this close. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.guardFar.tooltip: The guard stays put until the guarded one is further than this. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.guardAlert.tooltip: A hostile this close to the guarded one is attacked. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.guardChase.tooltip: A chase this far from the guarded one is given up. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.stayDrift.tooltip: How far a waiting mob may wander before returning. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.spokenOfferMinutes.tooltip: How many game minutes a row promised in words stays in the trade window.
mobtalk.tune.bargainCooldownMinutes.tool: Pause after a haggle before you can bargain with the same villager again. Game minutes.
